dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent structures exhibit irregular, jagged outer perimeters with a high-contrast transition from a dark exterior to a light interior. These are predominantly closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes concentrated in the mid-dorsal and lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized near the head and the ventral-lateral interface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-body region form a wide-angled obtuse triangle. A secondary cluster of four smaller annuli posterior to these forms an irregular trapezoidal arrangement.
